# Manufacturer support

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_support_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the camera registry
(`src/camera_count/registry/camera_database/`). Every method listed here
carries a citation, and every citation can be checked against the source it
names.

**A model that is not listed reports `EXACT SHUTTER COUNT NOT AVAILABLE`.**
That is the correct result, not a gap to be filled with a guess. If you can
cite a method for a camera that is missing, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/Osama01Anwar/camera-count-tool/issues/new/choose).

## What the statuses mean

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `documented` | A public source defines this field or operation as the actuation counter for this model. The value is read and reported exactly. |
| `hardware_verified` | As above, and a human has confirmed on a physical body that the count increases by exactly the number of shutter presses made. Requires a row in [hardware-test-matrix.md](hardware-test-matrix.md). |
| `unverified` | Recorded as a lead only. Never produces a displayed number. |

A model listed as `*` means the method is documented in that manufacturer's
main MakerNotes table rather than per model. It is used only when no exact
model entry matches, and it still reports the counter as unavailable when the
field is not present in the file.

### Nikon

USB vendor ids: `0x04b0`

#### any model with the documented field

| Counter | Method | Identifier | Status | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total releases | `makernote_field` | `Nikon:ShutterCount` | documented | `exiftool/lib/Image/ExifTool/Nikon.pm:2975` |
| Mechanical shutter | `makernote_field` | `Nikon:MechanicalShutterCount` | documented | `exiftool/lib/Image/ExifTool/Nikon.pm:2142` |

- **`Nikon:ShutterCount`** - Main Nikon MakerNotes table, tag 0x00a7 ShutterCount, int32u, described in the source as the number of shots taken by the camera so far. Its notes state that it includes both mechanical and electronic shutter activations on models with that feature, which is why it is recorded here as total_releases rather than as a mechanical count. The same entry maps the value 4294965247 to "n/a", so that value is listed as invalid.
- **`Nikon:MechanicalShutterCount`** - Main Nikon MakerNotes table, tag 0x0037 MechanicalShutterCount, int32u. Written by bodies that count mechanical actuations separately from total releases.

Limitations:
- Both counters are read from an original file's MakerNotes. A file that has been edited, exported or re-saved is refused before any field is read.
- A count from a file is the count at the moment that frame was taken, not the camera's count today.

### Pentax / Ricoh

USB vendor ids: `0x0a17`, `0x25fb`, `0x05ca`

#### any model with the documented field

| Counter | Method | Identifier | Status | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mechanical shutter | `makernote_field` | `Pentax:ShutterCount` | documented | `exiftool/lib/Image/ExifTool/Pentax.pm:2276` |

- **`Pentax:ShutterCount`** - Main Pentax MakerNotes table, tag 0x005d ShutterCount. The source states it is used by all Pentax DSLRs except the *istD and *istDS before firmware 2.0, that it counts shutter actuations even when no image is recorded, and that it excludes actuations from live view and video recording. The stored value is a big-endian 32-bit integer encrypted with the capture date and time; ExifTool decrypts it, and this program reads the decrypted value.

Limitations:
- The source notes that this counter may be reset when a camera is serviced, so it records actuations since the last reset rather than since manufacture.
- It does not include actuations from live view or video recording.
- The *istD and *istDS before firmware 2.0 do not write this field; for those bodies the counter is reported as NOT AVAILABLE.

## Manufacturers with no documented method yet

These are researched conclusions, not omissions. Each note records what was searched and when.

### Fujifilm

USB vendor ids: `0x04cb`

ExifTool 13.59 defines no shutter- or actuation-count tag for this manufacturer. Searched on 2026-09-16 with scripts/research_exiftool_tags.py over lib/Image/ExifTool/. No exact count can be read from an image file until a source documents one. Note that some Fujifilm bodies expose a count of saved images, which is not an actuation count and must not be registered as one.

**No model has a documented exact-count method yet.**

### Sony

USB vendor ids: `0x054c`

ExifTool defines several Sony ShutterCount tags, but they are model-conditional and the source marks some of them as valid only for certain models - see exiftool/lib/Image/ExifTool/Sony.pm:3339, :3483, :3490 and the Tag9050a/b/c tables from :7644. Registering them needs per-model work, so Sony bodies currently report the count as unavailable rather than risk reporting the wrong number.

**No model has a documented exact-count method yet.**
